legal.title: Your data and terms of use
intention.find_job: Find a job, apprenticeship or assignment
intention.find_provider: Find a provider or AI tool
legal.0.heading: Who processes your data.
legal.0.body: NaoMakers, organizer of GenAI Days 2026, is the data controller. Contact: [NaoMakers GDPR email address], [postal address].
legal.1.heading: Why.
legal.1.body: The application lets you consult the program, find other participants and exchange with them during the event on 17 November 2026. Your data is used only for this service.
legal.2.heading: What data.
legal.2.body: Data from your Billetweb registration: last name, first name and email address. Data you enter or validate: LinkedIn profile URL, photo, job title, company, company size and sector, professional tags, intentions, introduction and AI experience. Usage data: connection requests, messages, liked sessions and session feedback. Profile fields may be prefilled from your public LinkedIn profile by our enrichment provider. You can edit all of them.
legal.3.heading: Who sees what.
legal.3.body: Other application users can see your profile. Messages are visible only to the people in the conversation. Your session likes remain private. Session feedback is public and visible to speakers. Your data is neither sold nor shared with sponsors.
legal.4.heading: Legal basis.
legal.4.body: Your consent, given by ticking the box at registration. You can withdraw it at any time by deleting your account from “My profile”.
legal.5.heading: Retention period.
legal.5.body: Messaging closes on 24 November 2026. All application data is deleted on 17 December 2026.
legal.6.heading: Service providers.
legal.6.body: We use providers for hosting, messaging, sending emails, profile enrichment and the application’s artificial intelligence features. Some may process data outside the European Union. These transfers are governed by the European Commission’s standard contractual clauses.
legal.7.heading: Your rights.
legal.7.body: You have rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability. Write to [NaoMakers GDPR email address]. You may also contact the CNIL (French data protection authority) at cnil.fr.
legal.8.heading: Usage rules.
legal.8.body: The application is for professional and respectful exchanges. Harassment, abusive or discriminatory remarks and mass sending of identical messages are prohibited. Each user can block or report an account. The organizing team reviews reports and may suspend an account without notice.
legal.9.heading: Changes.
legal.9.body: NaoMakers may update this page. The date of the last update appears below.
